key_finding: Three PX[DE]XX[KR] motifs form the matrix salt-bridge network; three [FY][DE]XX[KR] motifs form the cytoplasmic network; interaction energies classify carriers as exchangers or uniporters
context: Comparative analysis of SLC25 sequences and structures
confidence_and_limitations: High for the framework; defines the criteria scored here, not MTCH2 evidence itself

claim_tested: MTCH2/MTCH1 lack the PX[DE]XX[KR] and [FY][DE]XX[KR] motifs
key_finding: 12/12 canonical carriers have 2-3 matrix motifs (permutation p<=0.019); 9 vertebrate MTCH2 + 3 MTCH1 + 5 invertebrate/basal MTCH have 0, equal to the random background (null mean 0.06-0.19). Drosophila Mtch has 1, p=0.143 (not above background)
context: UniProt sequences, 12 carriers vs 18 MTCH homologues
confidence_and_limitations: High; alignment-free so not sensitive to alignment error. Regex is strict, relaxed variants not scored

citation: This work (AAC1-anchored pairwise alignment, BLOSUM62 affine NW)
claim_tested: Retention of 27 diagnostic AAC1 positions (9 matrix, 6 cytoplasmic, 12 substrate contact points)
key_finding: Canonical carriers 44-100% retained (median 63%); MTCH2 orthologs 15-37%; MTCH1 30%
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; pairwise identity is 18.5%, so residual MTCH hits are at alignment-noise level and should not be read as partial retention

claim_tested: Are the conserved glutamine braces lost
key_finding: Only 3 AAC1 glutamines are >=50% conserved across canonical carriers (mature Q36, Q38, Q96). MTCH retains 1.00 of 3 (Q36-equivalent, QG[EKQSAN] pattern) vs 2.17 of 3 in carriers (Mann-Whitney U=185, p=1.6e-4)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; the braces are degraded rather than wholly absent, so the seed hypothesis slightly overstates this one component

citation: PDB 12OY (Stevens et al., PMID:42308315) + this work (geometry)
claim_tested: Does MTCH2 have a closed three-fold matrix gate
key_finding: AAC1 1OKC: E29-R137 2.83 A, D231-K32 2.84 A, D134-R234 3.04 A, separated by 113/118/129 degrees, 3.6 A z-spread, 4.3-6.8 A from the pseudo-symmetry axis. MTCH2 12OY: only 4 non-local salt bridges, z from -17.6 to +13.0 A, radius 3.5-15.8 A, no three-fold arrangement
context: Bovine AAC1 c-state crystal structure vs human MTCH2 cryo-EM 3.6 A
confidence_and_limitations: High; direct measurement on experimental coordinates. Only one MTCH2 conformational state is available

citation: This work (helix span along membrane normal)
claim_tested: Does MTCH2 keep the six-helix carrier fold
key_finding: AAC1 6 membrane-spanning helices; MTCH2 5 plus a non-spanning C-terminal helix 265-277 (7.9 A span) where H6 would sit
confidence_and_limitations: High; matches the independent cryo-EM report of TM-helix loss

claim_tested: Origin and mechanism of the MTCH fold
key_finding: MTCH insertases are conserved across holozoa, diverged from SLC25 transporters; insertase activity required loss of a TM helix creating a lipid-accessible hydrophilic groove stabilised by a structured C terminus
context: Human MTCH2 cryo-EM, mutational analysis, reconstitution

claim_tested: What is the MTCH2 molecular function
key_finding: Genome-wide CRISPR screens identify MTCH2/MTCH1 as required for insertion of tail-anchored, signal-anchored and multipass alpha-helical OMM proteins; purified MTCH2 sufficient in reconstituted proteoliposomes; concludes MTCH2 evolved from a solute carrier transporter
context: Human cells; purified protein in liposomes
confidence_and_limitations: High; reconstitution with purified protein is the strongest available MF evidence

claim_tested: Is insertase activity a property of the family
key_finding: MTCH1, but not MTCH2, complements yeast mim1/mim2 deletion, restoring MIM substrate biogenesis, TOM stability and mitochondrial morphology
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; paralog-specific behaviour in a heterologous system

claim_tested: Is the groove a lipid pathway
key_finding: Coarse-grained and atomistic MD show MTCH2 lowers the lipid flip-flop barrier, with in silico scrambling rates similar to VDAC
confidence_and_limitations: Low-moderate for annotation; no wet-lab scrambling assay with purified MTCH2 yet

claim_tested: Is the apoptotic role a direct molecular function
key_finding: MTCH2/MIMP knockout in ES cells, MEFs and liver impairs tBID recruitment, Bax/Bak activation and MOMP; no detectable effect on outer membrane lipid composition
context: Mouse ES cells, MEFs, conditional liver knockout
confidence_and_limitations: High for the phenotype; the molecular step is recruitment, and no transport assay is reported despite SLC25 transport specialists among the authors

key_finding: MOAP-1 binds MTCH2 and this interaction is needed for MTCH2 to engage tBid; MOAP-1-deficient mice resist Fas-induced hepatocellular apoptosis
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; places MTCH2 in a multi-protein recruitment step rather than an autonomous transport activity

key_finding: 12/12 canonical carriers: Pfam PF00153 x3, PROSITE PS50920 SOLCAR x3, 3 repeat features. 6/6 MTCH entries: PF00153 x1, SOLCAR x2, 2 repeat features. No MTCH entry has InterPro IPR002067
